page_title: STR 2-2 NIC | Strasbourg v Nice 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' 2 - 2 Gooal! Jonathan Clauss takes over corner duties. Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the right side of the net. 2:2.
90+4' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner.
90+3' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
90+2' Pablo Rosario (Nice) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Terem Moffi (Nice) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
88' Liam Rosenior has decided to make a change. Sekou Mara replaces Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg).
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Eduard Sobol (Strasbourg) for Dilane Bakwa.
87' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

86' A neat pass finds Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic denies him with a good save.
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Hicham Boudaoui will be replaced by Pablo Rosario (Nice).
83' Jeremie Boga (Nice) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
82' Morgan Sanson (Nice) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Djordje Petrovic, who smothers the ball.
76' Here comes a substitution. Badredine Bouanani is brought on as a substitute for Baptiste Santamaria (Nice).
76' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Dante (Nice) is replaced by Morgan Sanson.
76' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Gaetan Laborde (Nice) and he is replaced by Terem Moffi.
75' That's the end of the game for Valentin Barco (Strasbourg), who is replaced by Abakar Sylla.
75' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar.
74' Strasbourg are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
73' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
69' Liam Rosenior decides to make a substitution. Samuel Amo-Ameyaw will be replaced by Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg).
65' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Djordje Petrovic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
64' Baptiste Santamaria (Nice) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
63' Poor challenge! Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is penalised for tripping and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle.
61' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Mendy (Nice) replacing Moise Bombito.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.
56' That's a clear yellow card. Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) goes into the book.

54' 2 - 1 Andrey Santos is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 2:1.
51' 1 - 1 Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Marcin Bulka with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.

51' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
51' Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Nice.
49' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) comes off for Abdoul Ouattara.
46' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
40' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

40' Jeremie Boga (Nice) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Djordje Petrovic pulls off an easy save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nice are going to take it.
38' 0 - 1 Spectacular goal! Melvin Bard (Nice) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
37' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' A cross into the box from Jeremie Boga (Nice) is cleared.
33' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner with a short pass.
33' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

32' The ball is laid off to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the roof of the net and forces Djordje Petrovic to make a decent save. Nice earn a corner.
32' Jeremie Boga (Nice) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
29' Melvin Bard (Nice) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
28' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
26' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
25' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts the ball.
25' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Jonathan Clauss (Nice).

25' Melvin Bard (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
19' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
19' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Strasbourg for a penalty. Play continues.
18' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
17' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the right post.
10' Great save! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Marcin Bulka.

8' The corner is slung over and Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick.
8' Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
8' Evann Guessand (Nice) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' That's a well-taken pass by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
3' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
2' Melvin Bard (Nice) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
2' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Strasbourg will take a corner kick.
2' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Nice will take the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard will supervise the game today.
